name: Post
definition: A single piece of community content addressed by one identifier in posts.Id, discriminating questions, answers and wiki or administrative contributions through the PostTypeId discriminator.
scope: Whole content model of codebase_community

name: Question
definition: A post that asks the community for help, marked by PostTypeId = 1. A question is the only post category carrying a Title, a ViewCount, an AnswerCount, a CommentCount and FavoriteCount, and the only category carrying tags.
scope: Content analysis scoped to question posts

name: Answer
definition: A post that responds to a question, marked by PostTypeId = 2 and attached to its question through ParentId.
scope: Content analysis scoped to answer posts

name: User
definition: A registered account identified by users.Id that participates by owning posts, comments and votes and by receiving badges.
scope: Community participation analysis

name: Tag
definition: A topical label naming the subject matter of a question. Tags exist as rows in the tags table and are referenced by questions as delimited text inside the single posts.Tags column.
scope: Topical coverage and subject analysis

name: Badge
definition: An achievement awarded to a user, recorded as one row in badges with a Name and an award Date.
scope: Recognition and contribution milestone analysis

name: Comment
definition: A short remark attached to a post through comments.PostId.
scope: Discussion and clarification activity on posts

name: Vote
definition: A single voting action applied to a post, recorded in votes with a VoteTypeId and a date.
scope: Engagement and quality signalling

name: Post Link
definition: A directed relationship declared between two posts, recorded in postLinks and classified by LinkTypeId.
scope: Cross-post relationship analysis

name: Post Revision
definition: A revision event in the editing history of a post, recorded in postHistory with a PostHistoryTypeId.
scope: Content lifecycle and editing analysis

name: Post Score
definition: The net quality score stored on a post in posts.Score, expressing accumulated community voting on that post.
scope: Quality and ranking analysis over posts

name: Question View Count
definition: The number of times a question has been viewed, stored in posts.ViewCount.
scope: Reach and attention analysis over questions

name: Answer Count
definition: The number of answers a question has received, stored denormalised on the question in posts.AnswerCount.
scope: Responsiveness analysis over questions

name: User Reputation
definition: The accumulated reputation points of a user, stored in users.Reputation.
scope: Expertise and standing analysis over users

name: Accepted Answer
definition: The answer a question asker marked as resolving the question, referenced from the question's AcceptedAnswerId and therefore always pointing at an answer post attached to that same question.
scope: Answer resolution analysis

name: Bounty Amount
definition: Points offered or transferred through a bounty-related voting action, stored in votes.BountyAmount.
scope: Bounty analysis; populated only on bounty vote rows

name: Badge Count
definition: The number of badges a user has been awarded, obtained by counting that user's rows in badges.
scope: Recognition analysis per user

name: Post Type
definition: The category of a post encoded in posts.PostTypeId.
scope: Separating questions, answers and wiki or administrative posts

name: Vote Type
definition: The category of a voting action encoded in votes.VoteTypeId.
scope: Distinguishing upvotes, downvotes, favourites, bounties and moderation votes

name: Link Type
definition: The category of a post-to-post link encoded in postLinks.LinkTypeId.
scope: Distinguishing duplicate markings from general links

name: Post History Type
definition: The category of a post revision event encoded in postHistory.PostHistoryTypeId.
scope: Classifying creation, edit, rollback, closure and notice events

name: Activity Date
definition: The point in time at which content or an engagement event occurred, available across tables under differing column names and with differing granularity.
scope: Time-series analysis; granularity and coverage differ per table
